patterns-first-negative-correct:
assert first_negative([4, -2, -7]) == -2

www-build-message-correct:

assert price_of({"tea": 2}, "milk") == 0

while-digits-count-correct:

range-every-other-correct:

assert every_other([]) == []
assert every_other(["a"]) == ["a"]

lists-remove-zeros-while-correct:

remove_zeros(nums)
assert nums == [1]
empty = []
remove_zeros(empty)

grids-find-start-correct:
assert find_start(["#S", ".."]) == [0, 1]
